run_Pipeline: run a Pipeline instance to train, validate, and evaluate a generative recommendation model end to end
create_Pipeline_with_config: create a Pipeline with a model name, dataset name, and optional config file or config dict
create_Pipeline_with_checkpoint: create a Pipeline that loads a pretrained model from a checkpoint path for evaluation
review_Pipeline_init: review the Pipeline class constructor to understand how config, dataset, tokenizer, model, and trainer are initialized
summarize_Pipeline_run: summarize the Pipeline run method which builds dataloaders, fits the model, loads best checkpoint, and evaluates on test data
